hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; P="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; aec() { ( cd / && python3 -m aec "$@" ); }; aec code-impact --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- --exit-code || { echo 'Telosmith hook: the installed aec has no code-impact --exit-code; install a release >= v0.5.0 or the commit your CI job pins' >&2; exit 1; }; edges_out=$(aec edges "$P" -o "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" 2>&1) || { printf '%s
' "$edges_out" >&2; exit 2; }; check_out=$(aec check "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" --edges "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" 2>&1) || { printf '%s
' "$check_out" >&2; exit 2; }; [ -z "$check_out" ] || printf '%s
' "$check_out" >&2; aec snapshot "$P" --rev HEAD -o "$P/.aec/hook-before.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; out=$(aec code-impact "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" "$P/.aec/hook-before.jsonl" "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" --exit-code 2>&1) || { printf '%s
' "$out" '(Telosmith: stale/needs_review lines are status changes; structural pointer lines are candidates for attention and change no status.)' >&2; exit 2; }
